recommendations_general.text: It is recommended to base the revascularization strategy (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG) on the patient's clinical status and comorbidities, as well as their disease complexity, according to the principles of management of myocardial revascularization.

multivessel_disease_in_ACS_patients_pres.text: IRA-only PCI during the index procedure is recommended.
Staged PCI of non-IRA should be considered.
multivessel_disease_in_ACS_patients_pres.notes: Based on ischaemia, symptoms, patient comorbidities, and clinical condition (footnote c).

multivessel_disease_in_haemodynamically_.text: Complete revascularization is recommended either during the index PCI procedure or within 45 days.
It is recommended that PCI of the non-IRA is based on angiographic severity.
Invasive epicardial functional assessment of non-culprit segments of the IRA is not recommended during the index procedure.
In patients presenting with NSTE-ACS and MVD, complete revascularization should be considered, preferably during the index procedure.
Functional invasive evaluation of non-IRA severity during the index procedure may be considered.

abbreviations_and_notes.notes: a = Class of recommendation; b = Level of evidence; c = Based on ischaemia, symptoms, patient comorbidities, and clinical condition.
